messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Wed 25 Nov
Thu: Pg de Gràcia is shut for the lights switch-on and nearby metro exits close from 17:00. Fri: Los Fabulosos Cadillacs (Argentine) play Sant Jordi Club.

TODAY · Wed 25 Nov

1. BRESH CLUB
🕘 Tonight 23:00 → 06:00 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 1 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 From €15.50
💬 The Argentine party brand's weekly night in Apolo's main room, so a largely Argentine crowd. Ignore the tiny RA count: Apolo is pushing it in today's stories and it fills weekly; expect several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2585002

2. Salmo
🕘 Tonight 21:00 · 📍 Sala Razzmatazz 1
📊 Razzmatazz's main room; listed for tonight by three concert agendas, tickets still on sale
💬 One of Italy's biggest rappers in Razzmatazz's main room, the largest gig in town tonight. Expect well over a thousand, heavily Italian. Listings disagree on price, so check before you go.
https://www.wegow.com/gb/concerts/concierto-de-salmo-en-barcelona

3. AI AFTER: BCN Founders & Entrepreneurs Afterwork Hangout @Secret Rooftop
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Club 23 Barcelona
📊 62 going on Meetup · group has 149 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Founders and AI people having drinks on a rooftop, the best tech-crowd social tonight. A solid room of 50 to 70 by the RSVPs, and it is also listed on Eventbrite.
https://www.meetup.com/bcn-ai-circle-for-entrepreneurs/events/317302598/

4. VYBE l City Hall BARCELONA l BOUNCE ALL NIGHT LONG
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 City Hall
📊 231 interested on RA · also on Xceed
💶 Free guest list · paid €7–30
💬 Bounce and house at one of the central clubs, with a free guest list. The strongest RA number of tonight's club nights and it is on Xceed too; expect a few hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2581398

5. Live Music Barcelona | Wine Wednesday 🍷 + Meet New People
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Nomad House
📊 28 going on Meetup · group has 8,448 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Live acoustic sets with wine at Nomad House, an easy place to meet people before a club. Small room, likely 40 to 60: the Meetup RSVPs plus a separate ticketed listing on DICE.
https://www.meetup.com/bene-fit-international-community/events/317283520/

TOMORROW · Thu 26 Nov

1. THURSDAY l AGRESSIVE HARD l City Hall BARCELONA - MAIN ROOM
🕘 Thu 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 City Hall
📊 629 interested on RA · also on Xceed
💶 Free entry · paid €7–12
💬 By far the biggest RA number of the two days and entry is free, so the main room should be packed, several hundred at least. Hard techno all night, so only if that is your sound.
https://ra.co/events/2568626

2. Barcelona Thanksgiving Rooftop Party | Live Music, DJs & BJ Griffin
🕘 Thu 19:00 → 01:00 · 📍 Time Out Market Barcelona
📊 129 going on Meetup · group has 8,448 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Thanksgiving party on the Time Out Market rooftop with live music and DJs, an international crowd. Organisers say 200+ came last time and it is ticketed on DICE too; expect 150 to 250. Buy a ticket, RSVP alone is not entry.
https://www.meetup.com/bene-fit-international-community/events/317283359/

3. ProductTank November Edition
🕘 Thu 18:30 → 20:30 · 📍 Factorial
📊 162 going on Meetup (limit 260) · group has 5,454 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 The city's main product-management meetup, at Factorial's office with two talks on AI in product, then beer and pizza. A big tech room of 150 or so, good for meeting startup people.
https://www.meetup.com/producttank-barcelona/events/317328000/

4. Christmas lights switch-on show
🕘 Thu 18:00 (lights on 18:30) · 📍 Passeig de Gràcia, between Rosselló and Diagonal
📊 2,673 likes on @planesenbarcelona's post; also posted by @ordatwins and @barcelonasecreta
💶 Free
💬 One-off street ceremony: a stage show, then the city's lights go on. You stand in a dense crowd of thousands for half an hour, so go with friends you already have, then head on to the rooftop or a club.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgIoYYlhM-R/

5. COBRAH
🕘 Thu 20:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Razzmatazz
📊 188 interested on RA
💶 27€
💬 Swedish electro-pop club act playing Razzmatazz's anniversary run, an early gig that leaves the night free. Razzmatazz is promoting it and the RA count is healthy; expect several hundred in Sala 2.
https://ra.co/events/2481561

Scanned: Meetup 293 (partial) · RA 36 · DICE 25 · Xceed 14 · Eventbrite 144 · Luma 9 · Instagram 27 posts + 20 stories.
